methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series C → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.7x) to $400M last post money.

data.narrative:
AiDash, a Series C-stage infrastructure and logistics technology company founded by Abhishek Singh, has raised $91M+ to date. The valuation analysis relies on limited comparable data; no public peers or identified private comparables were available to inform this assessment.

A stage-progression methodology was applied to estimate forward value. Using the last post-money valuation of $400M as the base and applying a standard Series C-to-subsequent-stage step-up multiplier of 1.7x yields an implied valuation of $680M. This represents the primary quantitative anchor for analysis.

The triangulation range spans $578M (low) to $782M (high), with $680M as the central estimate. The narrow methodology set—relying solely on stage progression without corroborating comps or revenue multiple cross-checks—introduces material uncertainty into this range. The absence of comparable public or private infrastructure-logistics companies limits the ability to validate assumptions about revenue multiples, growth trajectories, or market penetration benchmarks typical for this sector. Material value drivers remain undisclosed in available data, preventing deeper fundamental analysis. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending access to detailed financial performance, addressable market sizing, and competitive positioning relative to established infrastructure technology operators.
